scope: Fresh production Java compilation and host JVM tests; no Android Activity/device/document-provider or physical Tesla execution.
checks: Normal PCM import stays staged until audio, analysis and both JSON files are complete.
Interrupted document-provider reads and explicit import cancellation clean all staging.
Autosave commits matching state/metadata, preserves extensible version-1 provenance and retains one prior revision.
Restoring the previous saved revision swaps both files and can itself be undone.
Corrupted and missing current project files recover the matching last-good revision and record recovery time.
Durable journal rolls forward at marker-only, state-replaced and both-replaced interruption boundaries.
Uncommitted stages and legacy temporary writes are cleaned without replacing the approved state.
An actual filesystem failure replacing a staged file leaves current state and metadata unchanged.
Startup removes abandoned new and pre-1.4 imports without following symbolic links.
A separate JVM halts without cleanup; the next process recovers exact prepared ZIP, filename and partial destination.
Prepared export recovery retains only one ZIP, cleans interrupted work, rejects non-document destinations and clears retry state.
Explicit discard and truncated-export recovery release the prepared slot without touching unrelated files.
Existing duplicate/rename/backup restore/CRC/traversal/cancellation and legacy rename-journal regression suite passed.
All 16 independent native FSEQ hardware/closure validation cases passed.
Native PCM conversion/resampling, supported WAV variants and incomplete-audio rejection regression suite passed.
WebView byte-range transport regression suite passed on the actual demo audio.

Production COOP/COEP/CORP response policy is same-origin and independently instantiated across unknown, empty, partial and large responses; ranges and MIME protection remain intact without cross-origin grants.
Durable background job ownership, checkpoint reuse, cancellation, conflicting edits, result commit and interrupted-process recovery passed on the host JVM.
Native Studio transform retains exact source-clock samples and stereo averaging; WAVE padding, malformed input and cancellation regressions passed without neural-model inference.
Playback proxy boundaries through the four-hour maximum passed.
Source wiring checks: package-derived version, frozen export projectState, native pause/save hook and background startup recovery are present (not device runtime tests).
